scholarships.name: Starter Scholarship
scholarships.description: The IBS Starter Scholarship covers 25% of the first-semester tuition fee. It is available for applicants of any Bachelor's programme, who, in addition to general entry requirements, meet the criteria.

scholarships.name: Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: The IBS Academic Scholarship offers tuition fee reduction for BSc students with excellent academic achievement who may, upon request, receive a partial scholarship, in which case IBS shall cover part of their semesterly tuition fee for one semester.

scholarships.name: Dr Frances Robinson Scholarship
scholarships.description: IBS founded the Dr Frances Robinson Scholarship in May 2022. Dr Robinson worked as the Head of Collaborations at the University of Buckingham from January 2011 until April 2022. scholarships.name: Budapest Master's and MBA Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Budapest Master's Scholarship offers 10-35% discount from the first payment of the tuition fee, for those who have a Bachelor's degree with a CGPA of 3.00-4.00 or 75-100% average in your Bachelor's degree certificate.

scholarships.name: Vienna Master's Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Vienna Master's Scholarship offers 10-35% discount from the first payment of the tuition fee, for those who have a Bachelor's degree with a CGPA of 3.00-4.00 or 75-100% average in your Bachelor's degree certificate.

scholarships.name: PhD Scholarship - Graduate Teaching Assistants (GTA)
scholarships.description: The IBS PhD Scholarship is for those enrolled PhD students who teach on regular modules at IBS. GTAs normally act as seminar tutors at BSc level – but there may be exceptions to this general rule based on academic and/or industry expertise.
